property_summary: When the game is open to the public and a real player has an active wager that was placed in an earlier block (so their timestamp is strictly less than the current block number), calling play() never reverts; it either pays the winner or records a loss, but always clears the player's wager and timestamp.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `play(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
